camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeCloudAssistantStatus --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF2 --PageNumber 1 --OSType Windows --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp1iudwa5b1tqa0000'
description_en: Queries whether Cloud Assistant Agent is installed on one or more instances. If Cloud Assistant is installed, the response also includes the total number of command executions, the number of ongoing executions, and the time of the most recent command execution
description_zh: 调用DescribeCloudAssistantStatus查询一台或者多台实例是否安装了云助手Agent。如果已安装了云助手，还将查询云助手命令执行的总数量、正在执行的数量以及最近一次命令执行的时间
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-cloud-assistant-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --os-type Windows --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF2 --instance-id i-bp1iudwa5b1tqa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudAssistantStatus

InstanceCloudAssistantStatus.description_en: The Cloud Assistant installation status of the instances
InstanceCloudAssistantStatus.description_zh: 实例云助手安装状态结果集合

ActiveTaskCount.description_en: The number of tasks that Cloud Assistant is running on the instance
ActiveTaskCount.description_zh: 实例内的云助手运行中的任务数

CloudAssistantStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether Cloud Assistant is running on the instance. Valid values:

true: A heartbeat has been detected within the last 2 minutes.

false: No heartbeat has been detected within the last 2 minutes
CloudAssistantStatus.description_zh:
实例内的云助手是否在运行中。可能值：

true：2分钟内有心跳。

false：2分钟内无心跳

CloudAssistantVersion.description_en: The version number of Cloud Assistant Agent. This value is empty if Cloud Assistant Agent is not installed or not running
CloudAssistantVersion.description_zh: 云助手Agent版本号，若未安装或未运行云助手Agent，则该值为空

InvocationCount.description_en: The number of tasks that Cloud Assistant has completed on the instance
InvocationCount.description_zh: 实例内的云助手已完成的任务数

LastHeartbeatTime.description_en: The time of the most recent heartbeat from Cloud Assistant. This value is updated approximately every minute, with a random fluctuation of up to 5 seconds (minimum 55 seconds, maximum 65 seconds)
LastHeartbeatTime.description_zh: 云助手最近一次心跳时间。该值平均每分钟（有上下5秒的随机浮动，最短55秒，最长65秒）更新一次

LastInvokedTime.description_en: The time of the most recent command execution
LastInvokedTime.description_zh: 最近一次命令执行的时间

OSType.description_en:
The operating system type of the instance. Valid values:

Windows
Linux
FreeBSD
OSType.description_zh:
实例操作系统类型。可能值：

Windows。
Linux。
FreeBSD

SupportSessionManager.description_en:
Indicates whether Cloud Assistant on the instance supports session management. If session management is not supported, the Cloud Assistant version is outdated. Update the client to the latest version.

The minimum Cloud Assistant versions that support session management are:
Linux: 2.2.3.189
Windows: 2.1.3.189
SupportSessionManager.description_zh:
实例内的云助手是否支持会话管理功能。若不支持，表示云助手版本较低，请将客户端更新至最新版本。

云助手支持会话管理功能的最低版本如下：
Linux：2.2.3.189
Windows：2.1.3.189

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
